available_invariants.name: Counter value matches model
available_invariants.description: The on-chain count must always equal the shadow model's expected value.

available_invariants.name: No negative balance
available_invariants.description: No tracked balance may ever go negative.

available_invariants.name: Supply conservation
available_invariants.description: The sum of every tracked balance must always equal the tracked total supply.

available_invariants.name: Auth required for mutation
available_invariants.description: A mutation that declares a required authorizer must not succeed unless that authorizer was in the step's authorized set.

available_invariants.name: Escrow status matches model
available_invariants.description: The on-chain escrow status must always match the shadow model's expected state.
